summary: Infrastructure & DevOps setup complete: CI/CD pipeline, Dockerfile, .env.example, rate limiting middleware, Zod env validation, unified auth (removed duplicate adminAuth.ts), Zod validation on all API mutation routes.
knownIssues: Pre-existing TypeScript JSX errors in src/app/**/*.tsx (not introduced by this PR — the next.config.mjs already had ignoreBuildErrors: true to suppress them).
Rate limiter uses in-memory store — safe for single-instance deployments but should be replaced with Redis/Upstash for horizontally scaled or edge deployments.
next lint hangs interactively in this environment (no ESLint config existed prior). Created .eslintrc.json; lint will run correctly in CI where stdin is not a TTY.
Vitest is listed in devDependencies but the actual test runner is jest. Fixed package.json test scripts to use jest. Vitest devDependency can be removed if desired.
Dockerfile CMD runs `npx prisma migrate deploy` at startup — requires DATABASE_URL to be set in the container environment before first boot.
SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true is set in the builder stage of the Dockerfile so env validation does not block builds without real secrets.
nextStep: Sibling teams should be aware: auth.ts now uses `role` field (string 'admin'/'user') from the Prisma schema — NOT an `isAdmin` boolean. Any session access to admin status should use `(session.user as any).role === 'admin'`. The shared requireAdmin() is in src/lib/admin.ts (single canonical location). src/lib/schemas.ts exports Zod schemas for all API bodies.
